alias.title: Set alias
alias.hint: The alias only changes how Git Rudder displays it; folder and remote stay the same.

rename.title: Rename repository
rename.info: Renames the repository folder on disk.

removeRepo.title: Remove {name} from the list?
removeRepo.info: The repository stays on your disk and remote.
removeRepo.alsoDisk: Also move the folder to trash

deleteWorkspace.title: Delete workspace {name}?
deleteWorkspace.info: Repositories are kept, without a workspace.

revokeSession.title: Sign out {device}?
revokeSession.info: That device loses access to your account and will delete what came from the cloud the next time it connects. If it never reconnects, it keeps what it had: revoke its tokens on each platform too.

resetHard.title: Reset --hard to {sha}?
resetHard.info: Uncommitted changes and later commits on the current branch will be lost.

deleteBranch.title: Delete {branch}?
deleteBranch.info: The branch may contain commits not on other branches.

forcePush.title: Force push to {branch}?
forcePush.info: Uses --force-with-lease: fails if someone pushed since your last fetch.
